spec.description: IAMPrincipalAccessBoundaryPolicySpec defines the desired state of IAMPrincipalAccessBoundaryPolicy

annotations.description: Optional. User defined annotations. See https://google.aip.dev/148#annotations for more details such as format and size limitations

details.description: Optional. The details for the principal access boundary policy.

enforcementVersion.description: Optional. The version number (for example, `1` or `latest`) that indicates which permissions are able to be blocked by the policy. If empty, the PAB policy version will be set to the most recent version number at the time of the policy's creation.

rules.description: Required. A list of principal access boundary policy rules. The number of rules in a policy is limited to 500.

description.description: Optional. The description of the principal access boundary policy rule. Must be less than or equal to 256 characters.

effect.description: Required. The access relationship of principals to the resources in this rule.

resources.description:
Required. A list of Resource Manager resources. If a resource is listed in
 the rule, then the rule applies for that resource and its descendants. The
 number of resources in a policy is limited to 500 across all rules in the
 policy.

 The following resource types are supported:

 * Organizations, such as
 `//cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/organizations/123`.
 * Folders, such as `//cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/folders/123`.
 * Projects, such as `//cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/123`
   or `//cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/my-project-id`.

displayName.description: Optional. The description of the principal access boundary policy. Must be less than or equal to 63 characters.

etag.description: Optional. The etag for the principal access boundary. If this is provided on update, it must match the server's etag.

organizationRef.description: The organization that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The 'name' field of an organization, when not managed by Config Connector.

resourceID.description: The IAMPrincipalAccessBoundaryPolicy name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.
